description: Hovering a launcher that is not running shows a text tooltip with the application name, and a long name stays on one line without being truncated.

assertions.comment: The tooltip is requested while the cursor rests on a launcher that has no window. Its delay is a QML Timer outside the virtual clock, so only the settled state is checked
The tooltip shows the application name from the .desktop file
A long application name is not cut off; the tooltip widens to fit it
The name stays on a single line
